_comment: Files that may stay unsigned in a release build (checked by build/check-signed.js). Everything else we ship must carry a valid signature. Patterns match the end of the path inside the app folder, '*' matches within one folder name. Entries here are an allowance, not an instruction: sign.js signs every file electron-builder hands it, these ones too, when it can. Explained in docs/signing-on-owner-pc.md.

unsignedAllowed.reason: Electron/Chromium library, built and shipped unchanged by the Electron project
Electron/Chromium library (ANGLE), built and shipped unchanged by the Electron project
Electron/Chromium library (ANGLE), built and shipped unchanged by the Electron project
Electron/Chromium library (software Vulkan), built and shipped unchanged by the Electron project
Electron/Chromium library (Vulkan loader), built and shipped unchanged by the Electron project
electron-builder helper for installing for all users, third-party binary shipped unchanged

foreignSignatureAllowed.reason: signed by Microsoft; a second signature from us is neither needed nor allowed to replace it

insideInstallerOnly.pattern: System.dll, StdUtils.dll, UAC.dll, WinShell.dll, nsis7z.dll, nsProcess.dll
insideInstallerOnly.reason: NSIS plugins from NSIS and electron-builder, unpacked to a temp folder by the installer; they are not on disk in a build folder, so no check can see them. CI signs them in the NSIS toolset copy before the build (windows-trust.yml); on the owner's PC they stay unsigned unless build/copy-nsis-plugins.js is used
